fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Teemo''' tosses a poisonous mushroom to the target location that becomes {{tip|stealthed trap|stealthed}} after arming over 1 second, lasting for up to 5 minutes and granting {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. If the mushroom lands on one that has already been placed, it will bounce forward from the placed mushroom for its cast distance, up to a cap, which can {{tt|happen repeatedly|In-flight mushrooms can chain into further bounces if they keep landing on subsequent placed mushrooms}}.
fields.description2: '''Teemo''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a ''Noxious Trap'' charge, up to a maximum amount.
fields.description3: The mushroom will explode upon enemy contact, inflicting {{tip|poison}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 4 seconds, as well as {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them.
fields.description4: {{sbc|{{tip|poison|nolink=true}}:}} The target takes {{as|magic damage}} every second over 4 seconds. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.
fields.leveling4: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|200/4 to 450/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50/4}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 450}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
fields.description5: A mushroom has {{sti|health|{{as|6 '''maximum''' health}}}} and can only be damaged by {{tip|champion}} basic attacks (2 damage from {{tip|ranged}} and 3 from {{tip|melee}}).
fields.description6: ''See [[Teemo#Pets|Pets]] for more details about mushroom traps.''
fields.notes:
* ''Noxious Trap'' deals {{tip|persistent area damage}}, additionally tagged as {{tip|indirect damage}}, and applies {{tip|spell effects}}.
* The bounce can occur an indefinite amount of times while '''Teemo''' is alive. If '''Teemo''' dies before ''Noxious Trap'' bounces on another, the trap will disappear.
* {{ui|Rift Scuttler}} will not trigger ''Noxious Trap's'' explosion if it is not being attacked.
* Enemies who step on multiple ''Noxious Traps'' will only refresh the duration of the damage over time and slow.
* ''Noxious Trap's'' damage is determined when it detonates and not when planted, meaning if '''Teemo's''' {{sti|AP|{{as|ability power}}}} changes, the scaling is also altered to affect the active damage of all ''Noxious Traps'' so long as they do not explode.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will prevent the damage over time and slow for all units but will not prevent the detonation itself.
}}
